desc:
About 4 babies are born every second. Which one will you be? 🌍

🍀 RARE BIRTH WEEKEND: every Saturday & Sunday rare countries are 2x likelier!

HOW TO PLAY:
🎲 Spin the birth reel: real odds from 195 countries. India is 1 in 6, San Marino 1 in 900,000!
👶 Live a whole life in minutes: school, jobs, love, family, moving abroad
💭 Pick a childhood dream and try to make it come true
📈 Start your own business at 18, grow it and sell it for millions
👥 Four babies are born in the same second as you, even real players on your server
🛂 Collect stamps from all 195 countries in your passport
🏆 Beat the records: rarest birth, richest life, longest life
📋 Daily quests and login rewards

👥 Invite a friend: when they join, you BOTH get a Lucky Birth!
🎮 Works on PC, phone and tablet.

Nobody chooses where they are born. What life will you build?

Data: World Bank Open Data and UN statistics (CC BY 4.0).
